notes.title: Last update and some sad news
notes.notes:
Folks, this is the last announcement on "The Lazarus Sign", as I, as the owner of Iphigenia Games, have reached a point where the time has come to make a decision, and it is a harsh one for me to make. After a year of continuously listening to feedback and improving the game experience of "The Lazarus Sign", the time has come to set sails to new shores.  Iphigenia Games will cease to exist to then be rebuild as "Iphigenia Media" by me. The focus will shift from story-oriented RPGM-games to interactive movies.

Sadly, this also means the planned additional content to the game has to be scrapped as well as any efforts to work on localized versions.
During that process, "The Lazarus Sign" will be made free to download on Steam over the course of the next days.

As a last bit of update, there was a partial dialogue re-write especially to the character of Victoria Black, as well as an audio-update at some songs.

I want to thank everybody involved in the production of this game and especially all the players supporting our efforts and keeping this release alive until this point.

Goodbye, sunshine.


Stefan from Iphigenia Games

notes.title: Version 1.2 is live!
notes.notes:
Hello players,

the new "Intuition-mode" has been worked over a bit and appears now on some side quests, too!
Further, the dialogue options with Victoria during the mission "Victorious!" have been changed in a way that makes it a lot easier to continue the conversation and actually get the side mission "Sisters care!" that many players seem to have missed during the gameplay.

Additionally, some of the dialogue has been re-written throughout the game, following constructive criticism we received by some players!

With this, the game version is now 1.2. The updates will be installed automatically if have that option put on in your personal account on Steam.

Further updates, other language packs and free dlc's will be announced when they are due, most probably not before 2022, as the work-in-progress on our next project demands the vast majority of our time and resources now.

Thanks for your feedback, ideas and support!

notes.title: New difficulty mode: "The Intuition-Mode." - German version further delayed.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37524898/79079c31f200061326ef330f48a7e4d51ee45c15.pngJack's infallible itchy nose is part of his life insurance as a private investigator. With the new Intuition-Mode, he uses his experience and instincts to get an idea of the other person's strengths, weaknesses and personality traits.
The new gaming mode can be activated optionally at the beginning of every new game. The player will get a few hints, so it might be easier to take the best decision than before.
The game will be updated automatically as the new mode is already implemented!




Note:
The GERMAN localized version of the game will be further delayed due to the corona crisis work management situation. At the moment, all we can say is, that it will be finished sometime this year, as the situation is still a bit unpredictable.


And ...
At the same moment, a new project with an entirely different technical background and story approach has reached pre-alpha stage - we will release more information when it's due, but for now we can say this: It will be 100% FREE.

notes.title: Jack Hayes - The Lazarus Sign: German Version
notes.notes:
Thanks for the support and feedback on this game so far!

We are glad to announce that an entirely localized German version will come up until December 15st.
Other localized versions might be released later and will be announced separately. 
Steam users with a German language setting will get the updated version automatically. 
You can still choose to play the English version by using the game settings on Steam.


Iphigenia Games

notes.title: Version 1.1 is live!
notes.notes:
The first relevant update for Jack Hayes: The Lazarus Sign is now live.
Additions and new content:
- added new object related to the side mission "To suffer in silence"
- added journal at the hotel room to read about the progress so far
- added improved weather system that will make it rain more frequently

Bugfixes:
- fixed a bug related to the assertiveness-path on the side mission "Sisters care!"
- fixed several grammatical errors and typos
- added a few lines of additional dialogue at the ending sequence
- re-adjusted balance and difficulty regarding two decisions

Thanks for the purchases and the interest until now, sunshine!
